annotations.title: Reject or defer a finding's recommendation

description: Records that a finding's recommendation is rejected or deferred, with the reason. Used to learn which recommendations fit this website. The finding and its evidence_id come from webops_finding; when the evidence has changed since, nothing is recorded and the answer says to read the finding again. Nothing happens until the person confirms: this returns a summary and a code for tc_confirm.
name: webops_reject
title: Reject or defer a finding's recommendation
